{{Quote|I took command of a battalion of clone troopers on Teyr. I led them into battle. I lead from the front, not from behind. I know no other way.|Jedi General K'kruhk, on taking command.|<ref name="Jedi: Mace Windu" />}}
A '''battalion''' of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] was under the [[Commanding officer/Legends|command]] of [[clone battalion commander]] [[CRC-09/571|Seven-One]]<ref name="Shatterpoint" /> as part of the [[416th Star Corps]].<ref name="TCWCG" /> While the [[Battalion/Legends|battalion]] was stationed on [[Teyr/Legends|Teyr]], [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[K'Kruhk]] took direct command and led them during the [[Battle of Teyr]], ultimately resulting in high casualties. Despite the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] best efforts, the battalion suffered heavy casualties and considered retreating, but was persuaded to continue after the clone troopers under his command believed they could still achieve their objectives and that they were born to die for the Republic.<ref name="Jedi: Mace Windu" /> Commander Seven-One ultimately survived the battle and was promoted to [[clone regimental commander]],<ref name="Shatterpoint" /> while [[General/Legends|General]] K'Kruhk was so distraught that he abandoned the war.<ref name="Jedi: Mace Windu" />
